excluded: complete TCP conformance and general opening/reset hardening
delayed ACK, no-flight persist, congestion/fast recovery
universal output/translation/refinement proof and independent data implementation evidence

SYN-TX-AGE.interpretation: Record the latest actual SYN sequence-space send, including a SYNACK reply. A timer-driven SYN retransmission waits at least the current pre-backoff RTO; an early timer expiry waits without emitting, backoff, Karn retransmission marking or retry increment.

SYN-IMMEDIATE-REPLY.interpretation: An immediate simultaneous-open SYNACK response remains a required reply, not a timer expiry. Record its actual send time and reset the shared retransmission deadline for the replacement reply, without extending the user timeout, so the subsequent timeout cannot retransmit it prematurely.

SYN-HISTORY-SCOPE.interpretation: One SYN control position and one shared rtx timer. Preserve the finite data/FIN ledger, RTT/Karn semantics and user-timeout priority. Timer waiting is explicit; no new sequence conversion or host callbacks.
